correctness.rationale: The first accepted vertex fixes the output part, so the size-biased law and all moments follow exactly. Conditioning on a largest part and applying the bounded-range variance inequality gives the sharp fixed-largest-part bound; equality forces every other part to be a singleton. The small-largest-part range is strictly dominated, and the exact first difference of the remaining one-variable polynomial has a unique integer maximizer. An independent exact enumeration of all multipartite partitions for orders three through fifteen reproduced that unique maximizer; the repository verifier source was also inspected, but its saved success log was not used as proof.
